summary: Not a fire lookout: a 2009 bird and observation tower in Auburn Environmental Park, Auburn, WA, built with a state grant and a city ribbon-cutting.

access.note: Part of the Auburn Environmental Park. The 2009 article describes an ADA-accessible trail to the upper platforms.

visit.trail_note: Trail and 30-foot ramp reach the lower platform; an ADA-accessible trail reaches the intermediate and upper platforms.

events.note: Ribbon cut in June 2009 after a December ground-breaking; wood, steel and recycled materials; state Recreation and Conservation Office grant.

notes_for_editor: Not a fire lookout. The record sits in the fire-lookout set but describes a city birdwatching tower; suggest hiding it. The OpenStreetMap way is tagged building=yes, man_made=tower and tower:type=observation. The City of Auburn park page returned an empty page from our cache, so the tower's current condition and rules are unverified; the record's status 'standing' is unchecked.
